# CertScore.ai

CertScore.ai is an evidence-based public website scanner for pre-consent tracking, cookies, consent surfaces, accessibility, disclosure, and privacy-risk signals. CertScore findings are automated review signals, not legal advice, certification, or a compliance determination.

## Start Here

- [Run a scan](https://certscore.ai/scan?domain=example.com): Start a public website scan from a domain or URL.
- [How it works](https://certscore.ai/how-it-works): Learn how observed website behavior becomes structured review output.
- [Methodology](https://certscore.ai/methodology): Review evidence collection, findings, confidence scoring, and scan limitations.

## Developers And Agents

- [Developer hub](https://certscore.ai/developers): Entry point for CertScore API, SDK, MCP, and agent workflows.
- [Developer quickstart](https://certscore.ai/developers/quickstart): Request a self-serve API key and run a health-check, scan, and findings round trip.
- [API reference](https://certscore.ai/developers/reference): API v2 endpoints for scans, status, findings, and latest-domain resources.
- [SDK docs](https://certscore.ai/developers/sdk): TypeScript SDK usage for scans, findings, and domain lookups.
- [MCP server docs](https://certscore.ai/developers/mcp): Model Context Protocol setup for AI agents using CertScore tools.
- [Integration examples](https://certscore.ai/developers/examples): Agent workflow examples, evidence boundaries, and reusable request patterns.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://certscore.ai/api/v2/openapi.json): Machine-readable API v2 contract.
- [AI discovery manifest](https://certscore.ai/.well-known/certscore-ai.json): Machine-readable discovery for API, SDK, MCP, and agent documentation.
- Use `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with self-serve keys carrying `scan:read`, `scan:create`, and `mcp` scopes.

## Tools

- `scan_site`: Start or reuse a CertScore public-web scan for a public URL.
- `get_scan`: Retrieve the API v2 public-safe scan resource for a stable scan ID.
- `get_scan_status`: Check scan status by scanId, or by jobId for a just-created pending scan.
- `get_report`: Retrieve a summary CertScore Pulse report by stable scan ID.
- `get_evidence`: Retrieve the bounded structured Evidence JSON packet for a stable scan ID.
- `export_findings`: Return structured findings from a CertScore Pulse report.
- `list_findings`: List API v2 public-safe findings already projected for a scan.
- `get_pre_consent_cookies_trackers`: Retrieve the public-safe Cookies & Trackers (Pre-consent) report table for a scan.
- `explain_finding`: Explain a single CertScore finding with public evidence, caveats, and reviewer next steps.
- `get_latest_domain_scan`: Retrieve the latest eligible API v2 public-safe scan for a domain.
- `get_latest_domain_pre_consent_cookies_trackers`: Retrieve the public-safe Cookies & Trackers (Pre-consent) table from the latest eligible scan for a domain.

## Findings And Review

- [Findings catalog](https://certscore.ai/findings): Browse CertScore finding reference pages and evidence examples.
- [Sample report](https://certscore.ai/sample-report): See how public-web observations are presented for review.
- [Pricing](https://certscore.ai/pricing): Review available plans and scan options.

## Use CertScore Carefully

- [Terms](https://certscore.ai/terms): Review current service terms.
- CertScore observes public website behavior and retained evidence.
- CertScore output should be reviewed with internal policy, vendor configuration, and retained evidence.
- Do not describe CertScore output as legal advice, certification, or proof of compliance/non-compliance.
